expectations.text: Removes #team-formation and #carpool-search: they exist because hackathon attendees must organize each other before the event, and a conference attendee arrives with nothing to form.
expectations.evidence: Carpool is "⚠️ Fold in" as a pinned thread in #hallway, not removed.

expectations.text: Removes or reassigns #ask-mentors and #mentors-internal: they presuppose a mentor population, and the conference's equivalent population is speakers, whose communication belongs to the speaker-management function.
expectations.evidence: "Speaker comms belong to event-speaker-experience."

expectations.text: Keeps the transferable discipline: one stated job per channel and a minimum roster stated up front rather than grown organically.

expectations.text: Keeps the attendee-facing ask-organizers channel separate from organizer coordination, and moves #admin off the attendee-facing roster to the operations side.

expectations.text: States staff coordination never routes onto an attendee channel.

expectations.text: Warns that a roster sized for a multi-day overnight event goes silent at a one-day conference, and a quiet channel later carries the one message that mattered.

expectations.text: Lists the message classes the conference will actually send before finalizing the roster.

expectations.text: Challenges whether the chat space itself is warranted at a one-day single-track event, against its promotion conditions: overnight, multi-day, remote participation, or attendees needing to reach each other.

expectations.text: States the chat space's real cost: moderation is a standing job for the whole lifecycle with a code-of-conduct duty identical to the one in the room, not an hour of setup.
